_comment: KMD2 input schema for generate_kmd.py. Real e-MTA element names (NOT Line1_1…Line13). declaration_body values are taxable BASES by rate, EXCEPT inputVatTotal/importVat/fixedAssetsVat/carsVat which are VAT amounts. e-MTA computes total VAT (line 4), VAT due (line 12) and overpaid (line 13) itself — do not supply them (no such element/column exists). Output: a KMD2 machine CSV (primary) + XSD-validated vatDeclaration XML (secondary). All monetary values are EUR decimals with a dot.
_comment_cash_accounting: State it explicitly. true only if the company applies the special arrangements for cash accounting for VAT (kassapõhine, VAT Act § 44). KMD INF A column 8 (invoiceSumForRate) and B column 7 (vatSum) are 'filled in by taxable persons using cash-accounting for value added tax' (EMTA KMD INF instructions 2025-07); the generator refuses either field unless cash_accounting is true. Exception: a part B line with special code 11 (partial deduction, VAT Act § 32 / § 29(4)) in comments may carry vatSum.
_comment_declaration_body: KMD main form (declarationBody). Omit or set 0 for lines that do not apply. Rate lines feed e-MTA's line-4 computation and INCLUDE reverse-charge/IC acquisition bases (EMTA: the KMD is declared by rate 'including' IC acquisition and reverse-charge services). Their deductible VAT goes into inputVatTotal (line 5); for full deduction the two cancel. Lines 6/6.1/7/7.1 are INFORMATIVE breakouts (EU suppliers -> line 6; non-EU services + domestic reverse charge -> line 7) and must not exceed the rate-line bases — the generator rejects that. Rate lines, inputVatTotal and lines 6/7 are signed: a credit invoice, negative line or cancellation reduces the base of its period, so a month of credits only declares a negative rate line (AR-1473). With a positive acquisition part on lines 6/7 and negative rate-line rows in the same month, state rate_line_negative_bases.
_comment_rate_line_negative_bases: Optional, zero or negative. The sum of the negative taxable_amount rows of vat_report's output_vat_details that map to transactions24/22/20/13/9/5 (each row is a tax code's signed net for the period, split with the document lines where one tax name covers more than one acquisition part, e.g. EU goods and EU services; self-assessed reverse charge is already on the output side; never add input_vat_details rows), signed. Used only when an acquisition part is positive (line 6.1, line 6 - 6.1, line 7.1, line 7 - 7.1, each counted separately): the generator then compares those acquisitions with the rate lines' positive part (rate-line total less this amount). It cannot verify the figure and prints it when used; show it with its rows before filing. Omit or 0 when no row at those rates is negative. Never an estimate, and never set to make the check pass.
_comment_sales_annex: KMD INF A (salesAnnex): invoices issued to partners whose invoices WITHOUT VAT total at least EUR 1,000.00 in the period (inclusive; ordinary and credit invoices totalled separately; only invoices with supply at 24/22/20/13/9/5 % count). Select partners with `generate_kmd.py --select-inf invoices.json --side A`. buyerRegCode = register code or personal ID code assigned in Estonia (never a VAT number). Omit the whole key when no partner qualifies — output then sets noSales=true. EMTA's form is filled invoice-by-invoice: sum_per_partner=false with invoiceNumber + invoiceDate (YYYY-MM-DD, rendered DD.MM.YYYY in the CSV). invoiceSum = invoice total without VAT; taxRate = classifier value (e.g. '24', '24erikord'); sumForRateInPeriod = base declared on KMD lines 1/1¹/1²/2/2¹/2² this period. invoiceSumForRate (column 8) only when cash_accounting is true. comments = special code(s): 01 (§ 41/§ 42), 02 (§ 41¹ seller: leave sumForRateInPeriod empty, the generator warns otherwise), 03 (settled case only: two or more rates incl. negative supply, as returned by --select-inf with rate_rows: one line per rate, invoiceSum repeated, signed sumForRateInPeriod; other multi-rate or 0 %/exempt invoices go to a person, see references/kmd-inf-annex.md).
_comment_select_inf_invoice_list: Optional fields of an invoice in the --select-inf list (AR-1439, approved 2026-11-24; see references/kmd-inf-annex.md for which treatments are settled and which are recommended). original_invoice_number: text, the invoice the document itself refers to, from a link recorded on it (a reversal's reversal_of_id; an invoice header's metadata.original_transaction_id) or as a person reads it on the document; never derived from a similar number or an equal amount. A negative ordinary sales invoice is declared as a minus row only with it. cancellation: only on a cancellation entry (a reversal, i.e. a cancellation without a credit invoice), which carries the cancelled invoice's partner, document_type and figures as stored (positive), its own invoice_number and invoice_date, original_invoice_number, and {reason: 'transaction_cancelled' | 'issued_in_error' | null (set only by a person), original_invoice_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', turnover_arose: true | false | null (same-period cancellations: false only when it is confirmed that nothing was supplied AND that no payment was ever received, from the payment history or the person, never from amount_paid, which a reversed invoice always reads as 0)}. Only a sales invoice's cancellation can be declared (part A minus row) or left out with its original; a cancelled purchase invoice always goes to cancellation_review. Credit memos in the list should carry original_invoice_number too (from metadata.original_transaction_id), so an invoice both credited and cancelled goes to a person. Absent facts send the entry to cancellation_review, never to a guess.
_comment_purchases_annex: KMD INF B (purchasesAnnex): invoices received from partners whose invoices WITHOUT VAT total at least EUR 1,000.00 in the period, counting only invoices whose VAT is deducted in KMD line 5 this period. invoiceSumVat = invoice total WITH VAT (column 6); vatInPeriod = input VAT declared on line 5 for that invoice this period (column 8). vatSum (column 7) only when cash_accounting is true, or with special code 11 for a partial deduction. Invoices for cross-border transactions reverse-charged in Estonia (intra-Community acquisitions, services from abroad) are not reported. For a § 41¹ purchase invoiceSumVat = the invoice total with VAT as shown on the invoice and comments = 12. Omit the key when no partner qualifies.
